title: circaea lutetiana var. cordifolia
intro: Circaea lutetiana var. cordifolia, commonly known as Heartsease or Wood Sorrel, is a perennial plant species belonging to the evening primrose family (Onagraceae). It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Circaea lutetiana var. cordifolia include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic agent, making it useful for treating various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, tannins, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
